scientific_intent.scientific_task: Advance a bounded soft-sphere particle demo under gravity, dissipative pair contact and an external spherical cursor; preserve original spatial hash and bitonic-sort neighbor pipeline.
scientific_intent.mathematical_operation: Velocity-before-position gravity update and box reflection, then finite-radius spring/damping/tangential-shear contact velocity kick over27 neighboring wrapped grid cells. Source kick has no dt/mass multiplier.
scientific_intent.discretization_or_topology: 16384 particles seeded on jittered26cubed partial lattice; Float32 radius.023, grid64cubed cells width.046; descending hash sort; worldOrigin(1,-1,-1) and modulo64 wrapping.
invariants: All coordinates finite and inside source box after integration.
position.w=1,velocity.w=0; sorted indices are exact permutation, hashes descending, alloccupiedcellintervals exact.
Full state and pre-collision reordered state agree with independent all-pairs CPU oracle at one step.
accuracy_requirements: Predeclared1e-5 absolute physical-state tolerance, exactinteger/control metadata and actual input prefix, all5 direct dual-reference checks.
Eight-step native strictoracle fails and remains diagnostic/unverified; no tolerance relaxation.
scientific_intent.precision_sensitivity: Near-contact normalization is sensitive to tiny integration rounding; retained per-step actual-state audit distinguishes exact neighbor metadata from continuous-force/trajectory errors. No full zero-distance or long-time physical stability certificate.
scientific_intent.input_size_regimes: Original16384 andgrid64 source size retained; primary1step vs source10000, strictdiagnostic8. Allsourceparameterbranches notexercised, cursor unreachablefixedcase.
